title: Days until a warmer temperature
summary: For each day in a temperature log, calculate how many days a user must wait for a strictly warmer reading. Return zero when no later day is warmer. The answer at each position must refer only to dates that follow it.
requirements: Input is an array of integer daily temperatures.
Return an equally sized array: a positive number of days until the next strictly warmer temperature, or 0 if none exists.
hints: A stack can store indices whose next warmer day has not been found yet.
When today is warmer than the day at the stack top, that day is resolved.
Pop all resolved indices before adding the current index.
